issues.legal_issue: The rent-control provisions governing premises let for specified purposes do not apply when land is leased for construction of buildings of any description rather than for one of those specified purposes.
material_facts: The lease covered land and allowed the lessees to construct buildings of every description, without restricting construction to residential, educational, business, trade, or storage purposes.
The lease permitted construction loans from prospective tenants as an exception to restrictions on mortgaging, charging, or assigning the land or buildings.
The appellant argued that the loan provision showed the lease was for constructing residential buildings; the court found that it addressed a contingency and did not define the lease’s purpose.
issues.conclusion: Part II of the Act, including section 18(1), did not apply because the land was not let for one of the purposes specified in section 6(1).
issues.legal_principle: Under section 6(1) of the Bombay Rents, Hotel and Lodging House Rates Control Act, 1947, Part II applies only to premises let for residence, education, business, trade, or storage. The purpose of the lease, not the lessee’s future choice about what to build, determines whether the premises were let for one of those purposes. Permission to take construction loans for residential buildings under section 18(3), when included as an exception to a covenant restricting encumbrances, does not establish that the land was let for residential construction. The court explained Mrs. Dossibai N.B. Jeejeebhoy v. Khemchand Gorumal & Ors. [1962] 3 S.C.R. 921, where land let for putting up structures for residence fell within section 6(1).

rule.if: lease_scope_dispute and premises_are_land and lease_allows_buildings_of_any_description and lease_is_not_limited_to_specified_uses

predicates.lease_scope_dispute: The dispute concerns whether rent-control provisions apply to premises under a lease.
predicates.premises_are_land: The leased premises consist of land.
predicates.lease_allows_buildings_of_any_descriptio: The lease allows the lessee to construct buildings without restricting their description or type.
predicates.lease_is_not_limited_to_specified_uses: The lease does not limit the purpose of construction to residence, education, business, trade, or storage.

issues.definition: When a dispute concerns leased land and the lease permits buildings of any description without limiting construction to specified uses, the rent-control provisions for premises let for those specified uses do not apply.
